value.name: walks instead of going home
value.description: She chooses not to go home and begins walking through the city.
evidence: She did not go home. She walked.

value.name: wanders to Rittenhouse Square
value.description: Without intending to, she ends up in Rittenhouse Square after walking north on Eighteenth and west on Walnut.
evidence: She walked north on Eighteenth and west on Walnut and she ended up, without quite intending to, in Rittenhouse Square

value.name: sits alone on a bench
value.description: She sits on a cold bench in the square and remains there without using her phone.
evidence: She sat on a bench. She did not take out her phone.

value.name: watches boy feed pigeon
value.description: She watches a small boy repeatedly try and fail to feed a pigeon a piece of pretzel.
evidence: She watched a small boy in a red coat try to feed a pigeon a piece of pretzel and fail and try again.

value.name: reflects on dead mother
value.description: She thinks about her mother, who has been dead for eleven years and left no house behind.
evidence: She thought about her mother, who had been dead for eleven years and who had not left a house to anyone because she had not owned one

value.name: feels envy at Serrano grief dispute
value.description: She examines her envy of the Serrano family's property-bound grief and recognizes it as sadness.
evidence: she thought about the strange envy she had felt, sitting in the Serrano dining room, of a family whose grief had property to argue over, and she made herself examine that envy honestly until it stopped being interesting and became merely sad

value.name: returns to office
value.description: After confronting her feelings, she gets up and walks back to the office.
evidence: at which point she got up from the bench and walked back to the office

value.name: works until seven
value.description: She continues working at the office until seven o'clock.

value.name: drafts firm letter to buyers' attorney
value.description: She writes a letter to the buyers' attorney that is firm but not celebratory.
evidence: She drafted a letter to the buyers' attorney that was firm without being triumphant.

value.name: drafts memorandum to file
value.description: She prepares a memorandum for the file as part of her work.
evidence: She drafted a memorandum to the file.

value.name: creates boundaries note
value.description: She drafts, deletes, and redrafts a private note to herself about boundaries, then saves it under a joking title.
evidence: She drafted, and then deleted, and then drafted again and saved, a one-paragraph note to herself about boundaries, which she titled, with the small humor she allowed herself when no one was watching, RULES OF ENGAGEMENT, SERRANO.

value.name: sets engagement rules
value.description: She records short rules for how to behave at the Serrano house, including not eating there and not staying late.
evidence: The rules were short. Do not eat at the house. Do not stay past business hours unless a specific document or conversation requires it. Do not address Daniel by his first name in the presence of his sister. Do not address Lucia
